body:
P2-29 FIX ROUND on PR #107 DONE: built, not walked (fakes only; nothing on a device, an emulator, VM 108 or the network). For the lead and the advisor.

DONE, each at the source, tests first and seen red:
1. THE BAR ONLY MOVES FORWARD, no qualifier. ProgressFloor (keyed by the SET of running keys) is replaced by CardBar (domain/download_card.dart): the last share of every job that RAN while the card was live stays in the total until no job runs; an ended or removed job keeps its share; a joining job holds the bar until the bigger whole passes it; an old finished download is NOT part of the card; a look where every running job is still starting (size unknown) does not advance it (else A ending would read 100 percent and the floor would keep it); fed on every look, app in front or not. Drop case red on the old code. Six mutations of it red.
2. STUCK IMPORT. ImportWatchState.stalled: server says running, no change of state/found/not found/waiting/kept for 30 min (same patience as saving). _schedule stops the 10 s asking; the import is ABSENT from the card jobs (not 'ready': that would post a false result card), also in the merged path (it lends its Download nothing, no dated card lingers). Seven mutations red.
3. The two unguarded claims are guarded: dated card never below on-phone; no heartbeat outside the app (the timer itself is checked by a test that ends with it still pending, which the test binding fails; the callback guard by a beat falling due while canPost is slow). Single-layer mutants are caught.
4. PB-43: the two known gaps with cost and removal trigger (a frame drawn in S-95) + KNOWN GAP comments in the code; the bar cost; the stuck-import rule. PB-38: the old group card may show once after the upgrade. CHANGELOG, S-95 caption re-read.
5. Transport comment fixed; areAllowed doc fixed; resultCardId cost comment.

DECISIONS FOR THE LEAD (mine, easy to undo):
a. WHAT THE PERSON SEES for a stuck import: the card goes away, with no card of its end and no new sentence (none is drawn). The import page still says what the server says; any change (a push, or the return to the app finding one) brings the card back. The half hour restarts with each start of the app (nothing is stored): worst case 30 minutes of 10 s asking per launch with a stuck import. If you want a word on the phone ('stopped answering'), that needs a drawn frame first.
b. Below Android 13 areAllowed is true: the card is posted with NO question ever shown (not even the S-92 sentence) and there is no in-app switch; only Android's own setting or the Downloads channel's switch turns it off. The downloader's old card did the same, so this is not new; it only sits uneasily beside ADR-R44 'nothing posted by default' and D-52 'asked once'. I amended wording only (the transport comment said the downloader shows the notification and that it needs Settings > Notifications: stale since D-52). Not decided here.
c. The S-92 sentence says 'While Encore downloads music it can show one notification...'; at a first IMPORT the work is saving on the server. Wording left as it is.

TO FILE (for the lead): (i) import stopped elsewhere while a merged Download goes on: no 'Import stopped' card; (ii) a failed import just vanishes from the card with no word. Both need a drawn S-95 frame first, then a test and PB-43 amended. Earlier proper fix still open: the server publishes import.progress when the keeper stores a song of an import, then the 10 s asking can go.

READ, not run, still: the at-most-four-file tail after a kill and Notifications.kt:629.

GATES (tree = main 74c17d4 + #107 + this round): dart format and dart analyze --fatal-infos clean; WHOLE app suite 3273 passed, 5 skipped (was 3248: 25 new tests); check_rows 162 Built rows, 0 without a test; check_order passed; the commit hook runs tools/check.ps1 -Quick. Server untouched this round.
